text:
CONCRETE PROPOSAL, from the API audit of all 78 exports. Verified: _pkgdown.yml and pkgdown/ are both absent.

Corrected comparative number: rMVPA's registry declares 21 symbols - 15 stable, 3 experimental, 5
developer - not the 13 I cited. The shape of the comparison is unchanged.

PROPOSED STABLE SET, ~12:
  relation
  abstract_domain / volume_domain / neuroim2_volume_domain
  voxels / searchlights / regions / whole_brain
  plan_geometry, geometry
  contrast / rdm / rsa / crossnobis
  connectivity
  as_neurovol

PROPOSED DEVELOPER-OR-INTERNAL, ~25:
  metric schedule family   compile_metric_schedule, materialize_metric, metric_components,
                           metric_capabilities
  numerics                 numerical_contract, numerical_agreement
  bridge                   measurement_space, measurement_bridge, reverse_bridge
  operations               inner_product, reduce_partitions, aggregate_first
  plus                     pairing_marginals, source_capabilities

Note on inner_product: it is the only exported member of a four-member family that is otherwise
private (R/operations.R:30-38). That is almost certainly an oversight rather than a decision.

Note on reduce_partitions / aggregate_first: these are two exports whose sole purpose is to name a
stage ordering. introduction.Rmd:241-246 is explicit that they name different estimands and that
neither is a hidden optimization for the other - so the DISTINCTION is Class II and must survive.
But the reviewer's suggested names, average_after() and average_before(), state the distinction
more plainly than the current ones do, so this is a case where renaming would make a load-bearing
distinction MORE visible rather than less. Worth considering alongside the tiering.

THE LINE THAT MAKES THE CASE: a reader currently cannot distinguish rsa() from materialize_metric().

Also confirmed by a second reviewer, and it strengthens this bead: rMVPA does not list ANY RSA
function on its own stable API - no rsa_model, no rsa_design, no contrast_rsa_model - despite RSA
occupying 10 of its 29 vignettes. The R incumbent treats its own RSA surface as unstable. A
declared-stable RSA path is available to effectagram for the cost of writing one file.
